{"id":1867249725,"question_id":4175,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"6 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1766897109,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"219 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1867249725/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Smallest All-Ones Multiple","memory":"10.6 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minAllOneMultiple(int k) {\n        if(k % 2 == 0 or k % 5 == 0) return -1;\n        int rem_val = 1 % k;\n        if(rem_val == 0) return 1;\n        int size = 1;\n\n        while(true)\n        {\n            string rem = to_string(rem_val);    \n            string num_to_divide = rem + '1';\n            int n = stoi(num_to_divide);\n            if(n % k == 0)\n            {\n                size++;\n                break;\n            } \n            else\n            {\n                rem_val = n % k;\n                size++;\n            } \n        }\n    return size;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"smallest-all-ones-multiple","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1413}
